Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You give copper and labour equal cost weight, but describe a much stronger movement in copper—it sounds like copper cost recovery is your central concern. We want to support a sustainable long-term partnership through a fair cost-based adjustment, considering payment timing alongside price. How can we reconcile the different index reference periods to establish a basis that works for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, under standard terms with a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. 

We have incorporated the verified decrease in the PPI-C241 index and your updated volume forecast into our revised calculation. To provide you with the most competitive unit price, we must decline the requested 90-day payment terms and maintain our standard 30-day terms. Following a review by our management, we propose €368.42 per unit, which fully accounts for the verified market data while maintaining a sustainable basis for our partnership. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.42 per unit. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You explicitly link the revised price to the cost of extended payment; it sounds like financing matters alongside the verified input-cost changes. We want a sustainable agreement for our long-standing partnership, without asking you to open your internal calculation. How can payment timing help us reach a price that fairly reflects the costs you need to recover?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). Our recent orders for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole were at 348.32 per 1 (po:4500014350-20, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014474-10). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 361.33 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

The historical purchase orders cited reflect past market conditions and cannot serve as a baseline given the significant cost increases over the last twelve months. Specifically, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. 

We have verified the recent LCI-C index data you provided and incorporated its effect into our calculation. However, our margin and our limits stay internal, and our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

Returning to our standard 30-day payment terms eliminates financing costs, allowing us to propose a revised price of €367.01 per unit. Therefore, our offer comprises a price of €367.01 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
